title: Update to seller feedback experience: Introducing star-only ratings [update]
summary: Note: This article was updated on July 31, 2025, for clarityOn August 4, we’ll launch a simplified experience for customers to provide feedback on you as a seller. Customers can now provide star-only ratings without written feedback— in addition to the option to provide written feedback if they choose.
